package main

import "fmt"

// An inferred-length array literal ([...]T) must cross the dependency boundary
// with its realised length so the reflect-based type resolver can rebuild it,
// rather than the "..." placeholder the declared type carries.
func main() {
	a := [...]int{10, 20, 30}
	fmt.Println("array:", a, "len:", len(a))
	names := [...]string{"x", "y"}
	fmt.Println("names:", names)
	grid := [...][2]int{{1, 2}, {3, 4}}
	fmt.Println("grid:", grid)
}
